The map shows '@' at (2,7) with open tiles all around (1,7), (2,6), (2,8), (3,7). Yet I can't move. The notice board is listed at (2,7) as "blocks" — it's occupying my tile and trapping me.

This is a genuine game-state blocker. Let me try one more thing: maybe the notice board needs to be read to unlock movement, and reading requires pressing E while the board is the "nearest" object. Let me try pressing E with a very long hold on the button.
